title: Version Lock Wizard and Performance Timestamp Cards
creator: Anika Rao
description: Summary: Build a guided 'Version Lock' wizard in the Console that lets product engineers pin a service/route to a specific model version and simultaneously publish an immutable performance timestamp card that records the profile used for validation. Motivation: customers pin versions to stabilize latency/cost and avoid silent regressions; however, pin operations are currently opaque (no one-click verification, limited metadata, and no snapshot that ties pin to a published performance profile). This ticket designs and implements a lightweight UX that reduces cognitive load during pinning, ensures traceability of the performance profile at the moment of pin, and integrates with rollout controls (canary / traffic split).
acceptance_criteria: Wizard UI accessible via model version dropdown and model details page; 3-step flow: Select target version -> Verify performance snapshot -> Confirm and publish pin

Published 'Performance Timestamp Card' is created as an immutable record and visible in the version's timeline with: timestamp, dataset/prompt-set id, latency P50/P95, tokens-per-second, quantization profile, and rollouts connected
Pin action supports optional immediate canary with traffic split percentages and stores the chosen split in the pin metadata
Telemetry emitted: pin.created, pin.published_profile_id, pin.canary_split_percent, and pin.initiator; events are available in analytics dashboard for 90 days
E2E test coverage for happy path and canary rollback flow; QA checklist items passed
Accessibility: wizard meets AA contrast and keyboard navigation standards
ux_flow: Step 1: User triggers 'Lock Version' from Model > Versions list or Version detail. Modal shows current runtime candidate metrics and lists available performance profiles. Step 2: User picks the profile to attach or chooses 'Run quick validation' (3-minute sandbox run). The modal shows a compact performance timestamp card preview. Step 3: Confirmation allows selecting rollout mode: Immediate, Canary (enter percent), or Scheduled. Final CTA: Publish pin. Success toast links to the version timeline and the profile card.
decisions: Ship wizard as a modal rather than a full page to minimize navigation cost
Performance Timestamp Card is immutable and append-only; edits require creating a new card (auditability requirement)
Default canary split set to 10% to balance safety and rapid validation
Quick validation will run in a sandboxed Dedicated queue with 3-minute limit to bound cost
alternatives_considered: Inline pin button (rejected): too little context for safe pin decisions
Auto-pin on successful validation (rejected): removes user control and increases risk of accidental rollouts
Profile auto-selection heuristics (rejected for MVP): prefer explicit user choice to avoid implicit bias
metrics: Pin rollback rate: target < 5% for first 24h post-pin
Percent of pins accompanied by a published profile: target 95%
Usage: % of active projects using wizard within 6 weeks
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Beta): expose to account admins and dev-orgs with opt-in via feature flag for 2 weeks. Phase 2: widen to all customers and enable by default for new model onboarding. Monitor pin.rollback_rate and canary success signals; if rollback_rate > 8% for >48h, pause automatic canary guidance and surface additional warnings.
qa_checklist: Wizard modal renders on desktop/mobile widths
Profile preview data matches latest published profile for version
Pin metadata persisted and visible in timeline
Canary splits honored by routing layer (integration test with ENG-4556)
Telemetry events emitted and visible in analytics pane
Keyboard navigation and screen reader labels verified
next_steps: Finalize Figma flows and hand off to frontend (Design review: DES-12021)
Backend API contract doc for pin.create and profile.snapshot.publish (ENG-4210 ownership)
Create integration test matrix for canary -> full rollout -> rollback
Schedule stakeholder review w/ SRE and Compliance (to verify audit requirements)
